snippet.title: [Stay with me, little bird... then stab- *bleh*] CLOCKWATCHING (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
=Game link: https://tokipetal.itch.io/clockwatching
=Commentary Version: https://youtu.be/07iUp6m17Qw

(Anyway, this is the one game I was referring to the post that interest me. Just mentions of animal unalive and a bit of blood, with a bit of yander-ness. That's all the warnings. Also recorded in OBS, so I can pause at least this time. Also unedited like commentary. Anyway, I'll be back in drawing break, now this has been finally discussed, before finally finishing the other games.)

Timestamp:
0:00 - intro
1:23 - game start/Readthrough
5:23 - Ignore him, like always Route (Pressing ESC also selects it by default.)
8:45 - Say hi to him for once Route
17:54 - game end (nothing else... or you can vibe) to outro/endscreen

CLOCKWATCHING is a short VN RPG Maker horror game, where you work in an unremarkable supermarket chain and found your coworker always sort of weird. This game has both endings. Also one of those that start immediately, and also with no audio, so I did some liberty and add some random VGM. And like some of the other games I played on the same vein, it also force closes/fake crash upon reaching the end of a route. so yeah. 

Overall, it's a cool game/VN, that's all I can say, and not much anything crazy. I guess one really cool detail is everything is blurry about the BGs, which is a cool attention to detail that the character barely to not really caring of working in the market I guess. I can say at least the character design as well is really cool. Overall again, a cool and a not bad game/VN. Tho they are working with another game and might check it out in the future.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy!

=BGM Used in video:
 - Detention Center ~Prisoner's Elegy~ from AA:T&T
